exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 Recommending a Classic
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Mia: Have you decided which classic to recommend for our book club, Leo?
Leo: Yes. I want to recommend The Old Man and the Sea by Hemingway.
Mia: Oh, I love that book. Why did you choose it?
Leo: It is short but powerful, and it teaches us never to give up.
Mia: That's true. The old fisherman is so brave.
Leo: Exactly. What about you? What will you recommend?
Mia: I'll recommend Pride and Prejudice. The characters feel so real.
Leo: Good choice. Let's share both books with the club next week.
exercises.translation_cn: Mia 问 Leo 读书会要推荐哪本经典;Leo 想推荐海明威的《老人与海》,因为它短小却有力、教人永不放弃;Mia 说书中的老渔夫很勇敢;Mia 则要推荐《傲慢与偏见》,觉得人物很真实;两人决定下周把两本书都分享给读书会。

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 Charles Dickens
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Charles Dickens was one of the greatest English novelists.
He lived in the nineteenth century and wrote many famous books.
His stories often describe the hard lives of poor people in London.
Many of his novels, such as Oliver Twist, are still read today.
Through his writing, he hoped to make society kinder and fairer.
exercises.translation_cn: 查尔斯·狄更斯是最伟大的英国小说家之一;他生活在十九世纪,写了许多名著;他的故事常描写伦敦穷人的艰难生活;《雾都孤儿》等小说至今仍被阅读;他希望通过写作让社会更善良、更公正。

exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 A Poetry Recitation Contest
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Tom: Are you joining the school poetry recitation contest, Lucy?
Lucy: Yes! I'm going to recite a poem by Wordsworth.
Tom: That sounds lovely. Which poem did you choose?
Lucy: Written in March. It's full of the joy of spring.
Tom: I remember that one. Birds sing and the snow melts away.
Lucy: That's right. What about you? Will you take part?
Tom: I'd like to, but I always get stage fright.
Lucy: Don't worry. Just practise a lot, and you'll feel braver.
exercises.translation_cn: Tom 问 Lucy 是否参加学校诗歌朗诵赛;Lucy 说要朗诵华兹华斯的诗;选的是《写于三月》,满是春天的喜悦;Tom 记得诗里鸟儿歌唱、积雪消融;Tom 想参加却总是怯场;Lucy 鼓励他多练习就会更勇敢。

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 Jane Austen
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Jane Austen was a famous English writer who lived about two hundred years ago.
She wrote novels about love, family and daily life in the countryside.
Her most famous book is Pride and Prejudice.
Her characters feel clever, funny and very real.
Even today, millions of readers around the world enjoy her stories.
exercises.translation_cn: 简·奥斯丁是约两百年前的著名英国作家;她写关于爱情、家庭和乡村日常生活的小说;她最著名的书是《傲慢与偏见》;她笔下的人物聪明、风趣又十分真实;如今全世界仍有数百万读者喜爱她的故事。

exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 A Visit to the Library
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Anna: Our class is visiting the city library this Friday.
Ben: Great! I love that place. What are we going to do there?
Anna: A librarian will show us the room of old classic books.
Ben: Wonderful. Can we borrow some books too?
Anna: Yes, each of us can borrow up to three books.
Ben: Then I'll borrow a novel and a book of poems.
Anna: Good idea. Remember to bring your library card.
Ben: I won't forget. I'm really looking forward to it.
exercises.translation_cn: Anna 说本周五全班去市图书馆;Ben 很高兴,问去那里做什么;Anna 说馆员会带他们参观古旧经典藏书的房间;Ben 问能否借书;Anna 说每人最多可借三本;Ben 想借一本小说和一本诗集;Anna 提醒他带借书证;Ben 说不会忘,很期待。

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 A Tip for Reading Classics
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Here is a simple tip for anyone who wants to enjoy classic books.
Do not give up just because the first few pages seem difficult.
Read a little every day, and the story will slowly draw you in.
If you meet a hard word, try to guess its meaning from the sentence.
Step by step, you will discover why these classics have lasted so long.
exercises.translation_cn: 给想读经典的人一个小贴士:别因为开头几页难就放弃;每天读一点,故事会慢慢把你吸引进去;遇到生词,试着从句子里猜意思;一步步地,你就会发现这些经典为何流传至今。
